O.outcome_detail: terminological uniformity and comparability of XR-simulation evidence

cells.quote: While XR‐simulation features were consistent in the literature, the variety of definitions and classifications complicated the development of a taxonomy framework.
cells.note: This scoping review proposed operational definitions and a taxonomy; it did not test whether the taxonomy improved learning or reporting outcomes.

result.effect: 40 of 46 studies (87%) found a positive correlation

cells.quote: The 46 studies that tested for correlation between NTS and TS often used Spearman regression or Pearson r correlation. Forty of these (87%) found a positive correlation.
cells.note: The review synthesized correlational and intervention/observational evidence rather than a single manipulated treatment comparison; the treatment/comparison labels represent the reported association between NTS and TS.
